verdict.rationale: Autumn publishes a public API reference covering core endpoints (track, check), billing (attach, multiAttach, previewAttach, createSchedule, import, customer portal) and licenses. The `atmn api` CLI command can call any public endpoint from the terminal, and an llms.txt index is served for AI consumption. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Attaches a plan to a customer. Handles new subscriptions, upgrades and downgrades.
Records usage for a customer feature and returns updated balances.
A new `atmn api` command calls any public endpoint from the terminal.
Creates a multi-phase subscription schedule for a customer.
You can also [check and reserve] balance in a single, atomic API call for concurrent events.
